items.raw_excerpt: The IamExpat Fair returns to Eindhoven on Saturday October 3 for its second outing in the city, with a bigger careers section, two international centres and a new kids area. The fair, which takes place in the Klokgebouw in Strijp-S, provides advice and services of all kinds for the international community, including special offers only available for attendees. You can register for free online. “We are bringing back the large career section, expanding the number of expat centres at the...
items.summary_en: The IamExpat Fair comes back to Eindhoven on Saturday, October 3. It runs at the Klokgebouw in Strijp-S. This year it has a bigger job area, two expat centres and a new zone for kids. Entry is free if you sign up online.
items.summary_ko: IAMExpat 박람회가 10월 3일 토요일에 에인드호벤에서 다시 열립니다. 장소는 스트리프-S의 클록헤보우입니다. 올해는 직업 구역이 커지고 외국인 지원 센터 두 곳과 어린이존이 새로 열립니다. 온라인 사전 신청을 하면 무료로 입장할 수 있습니다.
